json-format:
# Format JSON

Pretty-print the selected JSON with two-space indent.

Parses the selection and prints it back indented. Invalid JSON is reported with the position of the fault rather than silently reformatted. Works offline.

**How it behaves.** Replaces the selection with the result, as a single undo step.

**Where it runs.** Runs **offline** in VS Code — no network, no data leaves your machine. IntelliJ runs it through redbison.dev.

## Example

Selection:

```
{"name":"RedBison","tools":35,"offline":true}
```

Result:

```
{
  "name": "RedBison",
  "tools": 35,
  "offline": true
}
```

_Captured from the live tool, so this is what it actually returns._

## Running it

| | |
|---|---|
| VS Code | <kbd>Ctrl/Cmd</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>P</kbd> → **RedBison: Format JSON**, or right-click the selection |
| JetBrains | <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>R</kbd> → type `format json`, or right-click the selection |
